run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --suite standard-v1 --track custom --track-notes Same-machine baseline for the tuned run in this PR: identical configuration except the experimental speed-projection control vector is off and the GPU power limit is the stock 300 W (the tuned run used 200 W). 1M context, KV int8 with 32768 resident cells, 80 GiB RAM budget (all experts resident), MTP draft layer.
